opinion.headline: Become Arjun
opinion.hook: Modern life champions skill and achievement.
opinion.summary: Yet, a sense of unease persists. The Bhagavad Gita offers a timeless perspective. It emphasizes that true prosperity and victory arise when competence, represented by Arjuna, is guided by wisdom, embodied by Krishna. This alignment ensures success brings peace and well-being. Skill alone is insufficient; it requires direction.
